name: atlas-todo
//overrides: Pins patched versions of vulnerable transitive build-tooling deps (expo, jest, tailwind); bun has no nested overrides, so each entry is one version for every consumer. js-yaml stays on 4.x (4.3.2) and decode-uri-component is forced to 0.5.0 (GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr, reachable through expo-router); @xmldom/xmldom is not overridden because 0.9.12 breaks @expo/plist. source-map-js (GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q) and postcss-selector-parser (GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf; postcss-nested under tailwind 3 asks for ^6, forced to 7.x) are overridden past their advisories; the web export CSS and JS were byte-identical before and after. Revisit when an SDK bump lets these resolve on their own.
//audit-known: The `bun audit` findings no override can clear (as of 2026-11-02; node-forge left this list with 1.4.2, which the lockfile refresh took in its ^1.4.0 range). zod 3 (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5, fixed only in 4.6.6): @expo/cli, its only consumer, requires ^3.25.76. glob (GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4, fixed only in 14.0.2): its consumers pin ~7.1, ^7, =10.3.7, ^10, ^11 and ^13, and bun overrides are one version per name, so forcing 14 would break the callback-API 7.x users. minimatch (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, fixed only in 11.0.1): likewise, with consumers on ^3, ^5, ^9 and ^10. deepmerge (GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4): no patched release exists (4.3.1 is the latest). All four are build-time only (the Expo CLI and config tooling, jest and its coverage), never shipped in the app; the `Audit (JS)` job stays red on purpose. Add an override once a patched release fits the consumers' ranges.
